title: Room-Type Moves for Occupancy — Room Reservations
content:
## Policy

When the adults registered on a confirmed Room Reservations reservation are more than its room type sleeps, the reservation is moved to a room type that sleeps them, and the move is priced into the reservation's nightly rate. A move is made only on a confirmed reservation whose plan allows room-type changes and that was not booked through an online travel agency; it changes the room type and the nightly rate and nothing else.

| Before a move is made | Shown by |
|---|---|
| The reservation's status is confirmed | the reservation record |
| The plan allows room-type changes | the plan's change permissions |
| The reservation was not booked through an online travel agency | the booking channel on the reservation record |
| The adults registered are more than the room type sleeps | the adults and room type on the reservation record |

## Business effect

| Changes on the reservation | Stays as it was |
|---|---|
| Room type | Confirmation number |
| Nightly room rate before tax | Dates, adults registered, rate plan, guarantee |

The guest sees the new room type and the new nightly rate on the reservation straight away.

## Recording the move: `move_reservation_room_563d533b`

**Capability.** The tool moves one room reservation to another room type and records the nightly rate it carries in that room. Only the reservation's room type and its nightly room rate before tax are replaced, by the values given.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: guest services unlocks `move_reservation_room_563d533b` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | Reference number of the room reservation being moved, as returned by the reservation lookup for the guest's confirmation number | Identifier |
| `room_type` | The room type the reservation moves to | One of the five values below |
| `nightly_rate` | Nightly room rate before tax the reservation carries in the new room type, in USD | Plain number with 2 decimal places, such as 123.45; stored exactly as given, rounded to 2 decimal places |

Values of `room_type`:

- `standard_king` — a standard room with one king bed;
- `standard_two_queens` — a standard room with two queen beds;
- `deluxe_king` — a deluxe room with one king bed;
- `junior_suite` — a junior suite;
- `one_bedroom_suite` — a suite with a separate bedroom.

**Return.** A text receipt of a dictionary with the keys `reservation_id` (the reservation moved), `room_type` (the room type now on the reservation), `nightly_rate` (the nightly rate now on the reservation, USD with 2 decimal places) and `status`, the literal "moved", which shows the move was recorded.

## Questions on the move

**Does a move alter the guest's dates or deposit?** No. The reservation keeps its confirmation number, dates, adults, plan and guarantee.

**Can a reservation booked through an online travel agency be moved by guest services?** No; a move is made only on a reservation not booked through an online travel agency.

**Can a reservation on a plan that does not allow room-type changes be moved?** No; a move is made only where the plan allows room-type changes.
